definitions.necessity: loss: removed minus full; accuracy: full minus removed
definitions.balance: shared necessity minus routed necessity; the full term cancels, so this is not a responsibility fraction
definitions.shared_source_caveat: At fixed R, shared-necessity difference over S equals the corresponding old full-quality difference; it is not new mechanistic evidence.
definitions.primary: all 128; equal subject macro, paired question bootstrap within subjects
definitions.secondary: all-nine full-correct 33; counts and points only, no CI; selected on full-cell outcomes
